name: Role Permission Matrix
description: Version-controlled matrix that turns Role x DocType permission rows into live ERPNext Custom DocPerm records (and optional Role Profiles) via the 'Apply Permissions' button.

fields.label: Matrix Version
fields.description: e.g. v1.0, v2.0 - for the audit trail

fields.label: Upload Excel
fields.description: Attach an .xlsx (same columns as the export), then use Actions > Import from Excel to replace the rows below.

fields.options: Use Actions > Export Live Permissions to download the current custom permissions as Excel, edit the file, attach it above, then Actions > Import from Excel to load your edits into the matrix. Nothing changes in ERPNext until you click Apply Permissions.

Add one row per Role × DocType, tick the permissions, then use Actions > Validate Matrix and Actions > Apply Permissions. Applying converts each affected DocType to custom permissions (existing standard permissions are copied first, never lost).
